tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: Lists every e-invoice and bank statement format Klarbon handles, with what each can do now: open, check, convert from, convert to, make. Free, no API key needed.

tools.name: open_invoice
tools.description: Reads an e-invoice (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, Peppol BIS, UBL, CII and more) into structured data: parties, lines, totals, VAT, payment details. Optionally returns print-ready HTML. Free; without an API key the anonymous daily limit applies. Files are processed for the request, without a documen

tools.name: check_invoice
tools.description: Validates an e-invoice against EN 16931 and its national rules (XRechnung, Peppol BIS and others), with each finding explained in plain words and how to fix it. With country, also applies that country's national rules on top of EN 16931 (France: the CTC rules), only when asked; Klarbon never infers

tools.name: convert_invoice
tools.description: Converts an e-invoice to another format (for example UBL to XRechnung, or CII to a Factur-X PDF) and validates the result; only a valid file is returned. Costs 1 call per invoice from the account's API balance, or 1 credit once the API balance is empty, charged only on success. Needs an API key.

tools.name: convert_bank_statement
tools.description: Converts a bank statement file (CAMT.053, MT940, CODA, Norma 43, CFONB 120, BAI2, OFX, QIF and more) to another format such as CAMT.053, MT940, CSV or Excel, and checks that the balances reconcile.
